title: threads.json — normalized provider review threads
description: One provider bundle's normalized review-thread feed, written beside the raw host files (inline.json/reviews.json stay byte-identical). Each host's payload is filtered the way its review surface expects (dropped system/deleted/pending comments, host resolution state) and flattened to one shape, so ready/report and an agent can read prior feedback without parsing six formats. Unknown root keys are rejected: a new field is a contract change.

schema_version.description: Feed format version; only "1" is read.

provider.description: The host whose raw payload produced this feed.

truncated.description: True when a thread read failed or stopped at the provider page cap; the threads present are still trustworthy, the list may under-cover.

threads.description: One normalized root comment per entry, in host order. Replies stay in the raw files; the root carries the thread identity, state, and body excerpt.

thread.description: One root review thread or conversation comment: the fields every host shares after normalization.

id.description: Host comment (or thread) id as a string; empty when the payload carried none.

path.description: Anchored diff path for a review-comment, empty for a conversation comment.

line.description: Root comment line, null when the host anchor is a file comment or absent.

side.description: LEFT for a deleted-side anchor, RIGHT for an added/context anchor, null for a conversation comment.

resolved.description: Host resolution state when the payload carries it; hosts without thread resolution read false.

outdated.description: True when the host marks the anchor stale (the diff position no longer maps to the current head).

author.description: Root comment author handle or display name, empty when absent.

kind.description: review-comment for a diff-anchored thread, issue-comment for a conversation comment.

body.description: Root comment body, truncated to a short excerpt; the raw file keeps the full text.
